definitions: To do what someone else wants or expects, often to their advantage and sometimes against one's own will or better judgment.
To be controlled or manipulated by another person.
examples: She felt like she was constantly dancing on her boss's tune, never making her own decisions.
The politician was accused of dancing on the lobbyist's tune, ignoring the needs of the public.
He refused to dance on his ex-girlfriend's tune anymore and started living his own life.
synonyms: be at someone's beck and call
